dct_description_sm: Of children 6 to 14 years of age, the pattern of distribution is similar to that found for the younger age group. The most significant differences illustrate a lower proportion of this age group (relative to other areas) in Labrador, Newfoundland and much of the Maritime Provinces, with the opposite occurring in the Yukon Territory, British Columbia, Alberta and Saskatchewan. This age group accounted for 37.4% of all children, the largest proportion of children living at home.
dct_title_s: Children Living at Home, 1996 - Children aged 6-14 years, living at home
